_meta.note: CatalogMirror.cs computes its SHA-256 tag from whatever bytes upstream returned. That tag proves mirror-to-client consistency, not upstream authenticity -- there is no independently pinned expected hash to compare against.

scenario.mirrorBehavior: CatalogMirror serves the tampered bytes with a validly-computed ETag/SHA-256 of those exact (tampered) bytes -- the mirror has no independent source to detect the discrepancy against.
scenario.modeledEffect: Every client of this relay that fetches the mirrored catalog sees the manipulated basePrice as if it were authentic, and the relay's own integrity check (its self-computed hash) offers no signal that anything changed upstream.
